title: Developing a Speech Language Model for Basque
abstract: arXiv:2610.36911v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Although the recent development of LLMs has paved the way for multi-modal interaction, minority languages face difficulties keeping pace. This work presents the first open Speech Language Model for Basque, designed for low-latency, end-to-end spoken interaction. Based on the LLaMA-Omni architecture, the system integrates a Latxa model as its backbone, transferring its Basque capabilities to the spoken modality by fine-tuning several modules. To address data scarcity, the English VoiceAssistant-400K corpus was translated into Basque, and the audio was synthesized using a Basque TTS. Evaluation results confirm the system's viability, achieving 3.86/5 in content quality, a 9.94% WER for spoken intelligibility, and a 3.07 UTMOS for audio quality. This work demonstrates that advanced spoken interaction systems can be developed using modular architectures and synthetic data even in low-resource languages.

translated_title: 开发巴斯克语语音语言模型
translated_abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）的近期发展为多模态交互铺平了道路，但少数民族语言在跟上这一步伐方面面临困难。本工作提出了首个开源的巴斯克语语音语言模型，专为低延迟、端到端的口语交互而设计。该系统基于LLaMA-Omni架构，集成了Latxa模型作为骨干，通过微调多个模块将其巴斯克语能力迁移到语音模态。为解决数据稀缺问题，研究人员将英文VoiceAssistant-400K语料库翻译成巴斯克语，并使用巴斯克语TTS合成音频。评估结果证实了该系统的可行性：内容质量达到3.86/5分，语音可懂度的词错误率（WER）为9.94%，音频质量的UTMOS为3.07。这项工作表明，即使在低资源语言中，也可以利用模块化架构和合成数据开发先进的口语交互系统。
tldr: 本文提出了首个开源的巴斯克语语音语言模型，通过在LLaMA-Omni架构上微调Latxa模型并利用翻译语料与TTS合成音频，实现了低资源语言下的低延迟端到端口语交互。
en_tdlr: This work presents the first open Speech Language Model for Basque, achieving low-latency end-to-end spoken interaction in a low-resource language by fine-tuning a Latxa backbone within the LLaMA-Omni architecture using translated corpus and TTS-synthesized audio.
